requirements.title: Approaching
requirements.text: Pressing the up arrow changes the costume and increases the size.

requirements.title: Receding
requirements.text: Pressing the down arrow changes the costume and decreases the size. Think about how to do it.

requirements.title: Initial placement
requirements.text: When you click on the green flag, the rocket is always the same size.

requirements.title: Stopping other scripts
requirements.text: If you first press the up arrow and move the rocket closer, and then click the down arrow, you must first stop the approaching, and then start the receding.

requirements.title: *Bonus task: the Earth approaching and receding
requirements.text: When you press the up arrow, the Earth recedes, when you press the down arrow, it approaches.

media.title: The rocket approaches and recedes
media.text: Up arrow: the rocket is approaching. Down arrow: the rocket is receding.

media.title: Hen
media.text: The hen walks, eats, or turns its head when the keys "1", "2", and "3" are pressed. These actions do not happen at the same time.

requirements.title: The hen walks when the "1" key is pressed
requirements.text: We need costumes to change for the hen to take steps. How many seconds do we need to use in the "wait" command for the actions to run smoothly? Use the "forever" command to keep the chicken going.

requirements.title: The hen pecks the grains when the "2" key is pressed
requirements.text: We need costumes to change for the hen to eat. Use the same number of seconds in the "wait" command for the actions to run smoothly. Use the "forever" command to keep the chicken pecking.

requirements.title: The hen looks when the "3" key is pressed
requirements.text: We need costumes to change for the hen to turn its head. Here the “forever” command is also needed.

requirements.title: Initial placement
requirements.text: At the start, the hen always returns to its original position.

requirements.title: Stopping other scripts
requirements.text: When we start an action, we stop the others.

media.title: Skeleton and ghost
media.text: Fantasy characters are walking without our consent — let's stop them by pressing the space bar!

requirements.title: The skeleton walks
requirements.text: When you click on the green flag, the skeleton is constantly walking. Please note that only three costumes are used for walking. Use the "wait_sec" command, so that the animation is visible.

requirements.title: The ghost
requirements.text: When you click on the green flag, the ghost changes costumes. Use the "wait_sec" command, so that the animation is visible.

requirements.title: Stop the whole project
requirements.text: All the scripts stop when you press the space bar. The Stop All command immediately stops all scripts for both the skeleton and the ghost.

tasks.title: Stars
tasks.checklist_heading: TASKS WILL BE CHECKED BY THE TEACHER

media.title: Stars
media.text: Wow! So many stars — and each one can twinkle and change costumes and size! Press the keys 1,2,3.

requirements.title: The star gradually gets bigger and smaller when the "1" key is pressed
requirements.text: Use two loops in a row.

requirements.title: The star twinkles when the "2" key is pressed
requirements.text: The star appears, lingers for a while, disappears, and then it waits a little more before reappearing. Remember to use the repeat forever command.

requirements.title: The star changes color when the "3" key is pressed
requirements.text: Constantly switching multicolored costumes.

requirements.title: Initial placement
requirements.text: Three parameters change here. Think about which ones and set them for the initial placement.

requirements.title: Duplicate the sprite
requirements.text: Create 2 more stars. Right-click on it to duplicate it.
